findings.summary: MatchedRecombination::active checked node.eta < stop_eta at step start rather than step end, allowing a straddling step [node.eta, next.eta] or 1-ULP roundoff at stop_eta to advance delta_xe inside the REI-owned z < 20 segment.
findings.r114_resolution: Gate active() on step endpoint next.eta <= stop_eta + 32*EPSILON*(1+stop_eta), update doc comment at solve.rs:95, and add non-grid-aligned stop_eta test in r113_matched_recombination.rs.

findings.summary: invariants() inverted nonzero c.kappa for any Bianchi type; 1e-17 roundoff in rotated/evolved Type IV (rank(N)=1, n2*n3=0) produced spurious h ~ O(1e16) instead of None.
findings.r114_resolution: Restrict inverse kappa -> h strictly to types with nonzero n2*n3 (III, VI_h, VI*_-1/9, VII_h) and add rotated Type IV regression test.

findings.summary: isotropic_peebles_rate recomputed compton_temperature_k via None; solve.rs called rec.reference on node.eta unnecessarily and before checking x_ref_next >= X_MAX, and recomputed 2048-direction compton_temperature_k(&rsky) on every Illinois regula falsi iteration.
findings.r114_resolution: Pass Some(temperature_k) in REC isotropic_peebles_rate; in BASS solve.rs, read x_ref_next first to short-circuit x_ref_next >= X_MAX, avoid unused reference calls on node.eta, and precompute compton_temperature_k(&rsky) once outside implicit_matched_step.

findings.summary: CLI validated --nmu/--nphi against --lmax even under --route harmonic, while failing to verify that harmonic collision grid (n_theta, n_phi) covers --lmax.
findings.r114_resolution: Parse --route before grid resolution checks; under Route::Harmonic require nt >= lmax+1 and np >= 2*lmax+1 while checking minimal nmu/nphi >= 4 even for node seeding.

findings.summary: Open geometries (K < 0) permit omega_lambda >= 1.0, producing zero or negative flat-FLRW matter+radiation energy in MatchedRecombination::reference.
findings.r114_resolution: Reject cfg.omega_lambda >= 1.0 at solve_general entry when opts.recombination.is_some() and guard e2 > 0 in MatchedRecombination::reference.

findings.summary: If an input sky before recoil scattering (e.g. harmonic Gibbs ringing) has nonpositive intensity, recoil::trial bisects 24 levels (4095 trials) before failing.
findings.r114_resolution: Fail fast at scatter_with_recoil_events entry if any input photon has nonpositive or nonfinite trace.

findings.summary: Ionization::cells_with_offset omitted an immediate added.is_finite() guard and retained zero-depth cells when total + added <= 0.
findings.r114_resolution: Check added.is_finite() and filter out zero-depth cells when delta_xe != 0 (preserving delta_xe == 0 short-circuit).

findings.summary: frames::relative_velocity used (gf-1)/b2 instead of cancellation-free gf^2/(1+gf); spin_sht::evaluate_at did not guard zero direction norm.
findings.r114_resolution: Use gf*gf/(1+gf) in frames::relative_velocity and guard norm <= 0 in evaluate_at.

findings.summary: Documentation/repository differences: (1) LOCAL_AGENT_HANDOFF.md suggests building R112 in a separate worktree, whereas AGENTS.md prohibits new worktrees; (2) THEORY.md:211 has +-A/3 vs code/Dossier II -+A/3; (3) THEORY.md:239 omits sqrt(6) PSTF/harmonic conversion note; (4) THEORY.md:357 omits radiation-total observer frame; (5) README_KO.md:144 quotes C_10 not in LONG_EPOCH_DEMO.json and mixes delta_tau vs delta_tau/tau in lines 150-153; (6) homogeneous_sky.rs:261 comment called total xe the hydrogen fraction.
findings.r114_resolution: Fixed comment in homogeneous_sky.rs:261; followed AGENTS.md pre-merge R112 snapshot without creating a worktree; recorded all R113 doc discrepancies transparently in F0 review without rewriting cloud history.

findings.summary: Harmonic collision cells overwrote full self.coefficients via SpinSht(grid_after) with uncentered ring/GL means (leaking ~1e-15 * O(1) monopole across 4000 half-steps), used (t t^T + p p^T) instead of projector(&e), and integrated HarmonicSky::moments over fixed grids (sum w_k - 4pi = +8.17e-14 on 19x38), inducing 1e-14 frame_rad drift in I/IX and 1e-5 L-pair jitter at C_4 ~ 1e-10 C_2.
findings.r114_resolution: Added HarmonicSky::absorb_delta, ring/GL-mean centering in SpinSht::analyze, exact projector(&e) in HarmonicSky::photons, and closed-form l <= 2 analytic HarmonicSky::moments (while preserving grid positivity/eigenvalue checks); reduced I/IX frame_rad to <=7e-17, eliminated initial slice grid dependence to 0.0, verified 221+3 Rust tests and V1 20/20 TSV byte-identity with final binary SHA-256 3b775cf326921797d9488f00c8e78261aa58e2b436b2128ee0ec8cefd6c38686.

verified_invariants: geom::lie potentials and kinetic::{wigner, spin_sht, lie_hierarchy} match Dossier II and sky_spectrum::analyze_rings signs/conventions identically.
Harmonic rest-electron collisions match PSTF BE exactly on (L+3)x(2L+6) grid; zero-depth segments emit matching events without SHT overhead.
Legacy solve* entry points and R112 CLI defaults preserve all 20 TSV outputs byte-for-byte (SHA-256 identical).
MatchedStep residual G(x) is strictly increasing on [0, X_MAX] and FLRW identity holds to <= 1e-14 in REC.
energy_frame solves T^a_b u^b = -rho_E u^a cleanly (1000 Monte Carlo 3D tests converged with 0 overshoots).
